title: The Omen
short: Five films including The First Omen
blurb: A 1970s trilogy following one child into adulthood, a 2006 remake, and a 2024 prequel showing how he came to exist.
note: The First Omen leads directly into the 1976 film. The 2006 version is a near shot-for-shot remake and adds nothing new to the story.
